title.en: How One Search Engine Became a World

highlight.en: I watched a single beam of light travel across the globe.
highlight.ko: 나는 한 줄의 빛이 전 세계를 가로지르는 것을 봤다.

moral.en: History is written in the quiet clicks of many hands.
moral.ko: 역사는 많은 손길의 조용한 클릭 속에 적힌다.

narration.en: I saw a desk lit by a small lamp, one hand typing a query, back to the camera.
narration.ko: 작은 램프가 비추는 책상을 보았다. 한 손이 검색어를 타이핑하고, 카메라 뒤쪽으로 시선이 가 있었다.

image_hint.en: home office at dawn, a person typing, seen from behind, long shot

scenes.image_prompt: home office at dawn, a person typing, seen from behind, long shot

narration.en: I watched a screen flash red, a headline missing a link, a finger tap and nothing changed.
narration.ko: 화면이 빨갛게 반짝이고, 링크가 없던 헤드라인을 보며 손가락이 튕겼으나 아무 일도 일어나지 않았다.

image_hint.en: computer screen at office, a finger tapping, seen from behind, close shot

scenes.image_prompt: computer screen at office, a finger tapping, seen from behind, close shot

narration.en: A new window opened, results bloomed, a cursor hovered, waiting to be clicked.
narration.ko: 새 창이 열리면서 결과들이 피어났고, 커서가 뜬금없이 기다렸다.

image_hint.en: search engine results page, a cursor hovering, seen from lamp's light, medium shot

scenes.image_prompt: search engine results page, a cursor hovering, seen from lamp's light

narration.en: I saw servers whirring, numbers scrolling, a city skyline reflected in glass, humming quietly.
narration.ko: 서버가 윙윙거리고, 수치가 스크롤되며, 반짝이는 유리창에 도시 스카이라인이 고요히 반영된다.

image_hint.en: data center at night, servers humming, seen from a distant window, long shot

scenes.image_prompt: data center at night, servers humming, seen from a distant window, long shot

narration.en: A screen flickered, a new banner appeared, a pop‑up asking permissions, people hesitated.
narration.ko: 화면이 깜빡이며 새로운 배너가 뜨고, 허가를 묻는 팝업이 등장해 사람들은 머뭇거렸다.

image_hint.en: mobile phone at midday, a pop-up asking permissions, seen from behind, close shot

scenes.image_prompt: mobile phone at midday, a pop-up asking permissions, seen from behind, close shot

narration.en: A sandbox opened, code streamed, a new feature named “AI suggestion” whispered into the interface.
narration.ko: 샌드박스가 열리며 코드가 흐르고, “AI 제안”이라는 새 기능이 인터페이스에 속삭인다.

image_hint.en: developer workstation at sunset, code editor visible, seen from behind, medium shot

scenes.image_prompt: developer workstation at sunset, code editor visible, seen from behind

narration.en: Billboards lit up, advertisers adjusted words, a dollar sign floated over an ad, silent yet powerful.
narration.ko: 빌보드가 빛나며 광고주가 문구를 바꾸고, 광고 위에 달러 표시가 부드럽게 떠올라 무언의 힘을 느끼게 한다.

image_hint.en: city street at dusk, billboards lit, seen from a distance, long shot

scenes.image_prompt: city street at dusk, billboards lit, seen from a distance, long shot

narration.en: I stood on a rooftop, clouds swirling like data packets, a server farm humming below.
narration.ko: 마당 위에 서서 구름이 데이터 패킷처럼 소용돌이치고, 아래에 서버 팜이 윙윙거리며 전개된다.

image_hint.en: rooftop at sunrise, clouds swirling, seen from a distance, wide shot

scenes.image_prompt: rooftop at sunrise, clouds swirling, seen from a distance, wide shot

narration.en: A child tapped, a search appeared, a video played, the loop of learning resumed.
narration.ko: 아이가 탭을 쳐서 검색이 뜨고, 비디오가 재생되며 학습의 순환이 재개된다.

image_hint.en: playroom at noon, a child touching a tablet, seen from behind, medium shot

scenes.image_prompt: playroom at noon, a child touching a tablet, seen from behind

narration.en: Progress wears no flags, only countless small requests answered one by one.
narration.ko: 진보는 깃발을 쓰지 않는다. 오직 무수한 작은 요청을 하나씩 충족시키는 것만이 있다.
